claims.assertion: CISC extracts per-trace confidence via ConfidenceExtractionConfig (temperature=0.0, num_tokens=10, verbal_eos_pattern=')') and ConfidenceExtractionType variants (NONE, BINARY, BINARY_FT, BINARY_FT01, BINARY_MP, HUNDRED), bundled in AggregatedConfidenceExtractionConfig across verbal_confidence, confidence_likelihoods, and run_sequence_probability.

majority_with_conf() implements confidence-weighted self-consistency voting supporting NormalizationType (NONE, LINEAR, SOFTMAX), frozen AggregatorConfig validation across four confidence column families, zero-confidence retention while filtering NaN/empty entries, tie-break-only mode, and normalized chosen-answer confidence output.

calculate_metrics_at_position() produces frozen ResultMetrics quantifying comparable_baseline_traces_needed vs standard SC (>40% path reduction across 9 models and 4 datasets per cisc/README.md), paired with calibration_util.py (compute_ece, compute_brier, TemperatureScaling) and WQD discrimination analysis over ECE.

distilled_learning: Replace unweighted self-consistency majority voting with temperature-normalized confidence-weighted voting (CISC majority_with_conf + SOFTMAX/LINEAR normalization) and evaluate selection quality via Within-Question Discrimination (WQD) rather than global calibration (ECE) alone.
